description: This header file declares the API functions for the Slap Access Manager component, used in Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) within the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes function prototypes for object creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization, which are meant to be implemented across different source files.

methods.name: SlapCreateAccessManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new Access Manager object, utilizing provided container, owner, and reserved context handles.

methods.name: SlapAmoCreate
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new Slap Access Manager object with specified context and reserved handles.

methods.name: SlapAmoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the specified Slap Access Manager object.

methods.name: SlapAmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary objects into the Slap Access Manager instance.

methods.name: SlapAmoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Slap Access Manager object.
